name: Maratopia - Masurao to Mahou no Shima
original_name: マラトピア - 益荒男と魔法の島
source:
The island I awoke on was paradise.

Living with spirits, interacting with the village men, a conspiracy surrounding the island…
Can I truly become a man of honor…?

-----------------------------------------------------------

A lighthearted erotic adventure game where the amnesiac protagonist awakens on a mysterious island and embarks on an adventure.

This time, your choices will increase the affection levels of the village men, and in the latter half, you can engage in erotic activities with each of their routes.

[From [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/tosi0150/archives/1053585735.html]ゲイまーの覚え書き (Gayman's Notes)[/url]]
translation:
我醒来时身处的这座岛屿，宛如人间乐园。

与精灵共同生活、同村里的男人们深入交流，还有围绕整座岛屿暗流涌动的阴谋……
我当真能成为顶天立地的大丈夫吗……？

这是一款轻松明快的成人向冒险游戏，失去记忆的主人公在一座神秘岛屿上苏醒，自此踏上冒险之旅。

在本作中，你的选择将提升村中男人们的好感度，进入后半程后更可在各自的个人路线中与他们展开色气满满的亲密互动。

[摘自[url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/tosi0150/archives/1053585735.html]ゲイまーの覚え書き（Gayman's Notes）[/url]]
